# 文档

- [G6Lite 是什么](/docs): 轻量图可视化，为大规模关系数据而生
- 开始使用
  - [快速上手](/docs/getting-started/quick-start): 安装 G6Lite，创建第一个可交互的关系图
  - [React 接入](/docs/getting-started/react): 在 React 组件中创建关系图并更新数据
  - [Vue 接入](/docs/getting-started/vue): 在 Vue 3 组件中创建关系图并更新数据
- [G6Lite AI 使用指南](/docs/ai): 用 AI Skill 在项目中生成或修改关系图代码，用 Sive 在线查询 API 和使用示例。
- API
  - [API 文档已迁移](/docs/api): 从图 API、事件参考和配置项查找公开接口。
  - 图 API
    - [图 API](/docs/api/graph): 查询图的构造函数、实例方法、事件和扩展接口
    - [事件](/docs/api/graph/events): 查询图事件的触发时机和回调参数。
  - [图配置项](/docs/api/options): GraphOptions 的顶层字段、默认值与分项配置
  - [扩展参考](/docs/api/extensions): 扩展的配置位置、上下文、绘制回调和生命周期。
- 图 Graph
  - [图总览](/docs/graph/overview): 了解 Graph 的生命周期、配置项和实例属性，运行一个完整的配置示例
- 使用指南
  - [视口与坐标](/docs/guides/viewport): 适配画布、保留用户视野、转换坐标并定位菜单
  - [扩展体系](/docs/guides/extensions): 先选配置或扩展，再进入对应教程和公共契约
  - [数据 Data](/docs/guides/data): 了解图数据结构、节点与边的增删改查、分组和远程数据加载
  - [元素状态](/docs/guides/states): 设置选中和高亮样式，增减状态并在数据更新后恢复选择
  - [节点通用配置项](/docs/guides/node): 介绍节点形状、数据映射、状态、标签、图标、装饰与动态更新
  - [自定义节点](/docs/guides/custom-node): 注册业务节点，添加轻量覆盖绘制与装饰边界锚点，并验证更新
  - [自定义节点装饰](/docs/guides/custom-decoration): 实现装饰内容的测量和绘制，配置定位、堆叠、排序、溢出与碰撞
  - [边通用配置项](/docs/guides/edge): 按场景选择边类型，配置样式、标签、交互、平行边与路由
  - [自定义边](/docs/guides/custom-edge): 复用内置边基型，注册业务样式、函数映射与状态，并验证数据更新
  - [分组通用配置项](/docs/guides/combo): 设置分组的边框、标签、状态和折叠样式，调整成员归属
  - [标签与图标](/docs/guides/label): 配置节点与边标签、节点图标、长文本、显示策略和运行时更新
  - [自定义 Label Renderer](/docs/guides/custom-label-renderer): 为节点和边实现多行内容，复用引擎的定位、旋转、碰撞和调度
  - [布局总览](/docs/guides/layout-overview): 根据图的用途选择布局，比较同一份数据的排列效果
  - [布局通用配置项](/docs/guides/layout): 选择网络或树布局，复用已有坐标，并在运行时重新排列
  - [网格布局 Grid](/docs/guides/layout-grid): 节点按行列排成网格。
  - [环形布局 Circular](/docs/guides/layout-circular): 节点沿圆周排列，半径也可以逐个变化，形成螺旋。
  - [层级布局 Dagre](/docs/guides/layout-dagre): 节点按有向边的关系分层排列。
  - [力导向布局 Force](/docs/guides/layout-force): 边的引力拉近相连的节点，节点间的斥力把它们分开。
  - [D3 力导向布局](/docs/guides/layout-d3-force): D3 的力模拟根据节点间的作用力计算位置。
  - [ForceAtlas2 力导向布局](/docs/guides/layout-force-atlas2): 相连的节点互相吸引，同时受斥力和中心引力影响。
  - [Fruchterman 力导向布局](/docs/guides/layout-fruchterman): 用边的引力和节点间的斥力调整位置，再用中心引力聚拢整张图。
  - [同心圆布局 Concentric](/docs/guides/layout-concentric): 按排序指标把节点分到不同圆环，指标值较大的节点靠近中心。
  - [缩进树布局 Indented](/docs/guides/layout-indented): 节点按树的遍历顺序逐行排列，子节点随层级加深而缩进。
  - [思维导图布局 Mindmap](/docs/guides/layout-mindmap): 分支从中心主题向一侧或两侧展开。
  - [鱼骨布局 Fishbone](/docs/guides/layout-fishbone): 问题放在主干末端，原因分类沿主干两侧展开。
  - [放射布局 Radial](/docs/guides/layout-radial): 节点按到中心节点的最短路径距离分圈。
  - [多维尺度布局 MDS](/docs/guides/layout-mds): 多维尺度分析（MDS）用平面距离近似表示图中节点的最短路径距离。
  - [随机布局 Random](/docs/guides/layout-random): 节点随机散布在布局中心附近。
  - [Worker 布局指南](/docs/guides/layout-worker): 启用异步布局、取消旧任务，并检查 Worker 回退与部署资源
  - [自定义布局](/docs/guides/custom-layout): 注册坐标计算，处理配置、取消信号和清理，并区分 Graph 执行与独立计算
  - [交互总览](/docs/guides/behavior-overview): 查看内置交互，配置、切换和卸载交互，并监听图事件。
  - [交互通用配置项](/docs/guides/behaviors): 组合浏览、选择、拖动、高亮和 Tooltip，并连接业务事件
  - [拖动画布](/docs/guides/behavior-drag-canvas): 从画布空白处拖动，平移整张图。
  - [缩放画布](/docs/guides/behavior-zoom-canvas): 滚动鼠标滚轮，以画布中心为基准缩放。
  - [点击选中](/docs/guides/behavior-click-select): 点击节点或边切换选中状态，点击画布空白处清空选择。
  - [框选](/docs/guides/behavior-brush-select): 拖出矩形，选中中心落在矩形内的节点。
  - [套索选择](/docs/guides/behavior-lasso-select): 沿自由轮廓拖动，选中中心落在圈内的节点。
  - [拖动节点与分组](/docs/guides/behavior-drag-node): 拖动节点，或从分组空白处拖动整个分组。
  - [拖动边端点](/docs/guides/behavior-drag-edge): 拖动已有边的端点，松开时通过事件获取重连目标。
  - [悬停高亮节点](/docs/guides/behavior-highlight-node): 悬停节点时，突出该节点及与它直接相连的节点和边。
  - [悬停高亮边](/docs/guides/behavior-highlight-edge): 悬停边时，突出这条边及其两端节点。
  - [邻域高亮](/docs/guides/behavior-hover-highlight): 悬停时高亮节点的邻域，或高亮边及其两端节点。
  - [提示框 Tooltip](/docs/guides/behavior-tooltip): 悬停或点击节点和边时，显示它们的详细信息。
  - [自定义交互](/docs/guides/custom-behavior): 实现独立实例的业务选择行为，完成注册、激活与清理
  - [插件总览](/docs/guides/plugins): 了解 G6Lite 的插件，以及如何配置、替换和卸载插件
  - [自定义插件](/docs/guides/custom-plugin): 实现、注册并使用一个点击计数器插件
  - [数据处理 Transform](/docs/guides/transform-overview): 了解 Transform 的执行时机，配置平行边和自定义数据处理
  - [主题](/docs/guides/theme): 选择预设、应用品牌色、切换主题，并排查样式覆盖
  - [缩放与平移画布](/docs/guides/behavior-navigation): 设置滚轮缩放速度、范围和拖动画布的手势
  - [点击、框选与套索](/docs/guides/behavior-selection): 配置节点和边的点击选中，以及节点的区域选择
  - [拖动节点、分组与边](/docs/guides/behavior-dragging): 移动节点和分组，或拖动边的端点并保存重连结果
  - 事件入门
    - [事件入门](/docs/guides/events): 从监听一次点击开始，连接画布操作与业务
    - [选择与拖动](/docs/guides/events/selection-drag): 同步业务选择、保存拖拽结果，并清理监听
    - [渲染、布局与数据更新](/docs/guides/events/lifecycle): 了解何时可以更新图、读取布局坐标或处理数据替换。
    - [自定义事件](/docs/guides/events/custom): 用工具栏按钮触发业务事件，并在页面卸载时清理监听。
  - [网格、环形与层级布局](/docs/guides/layout-arrangements): 用 Grid、Circular 和 Dagre 排列节点
  - [关系网络布局](/docs/guides/layout-networks): 按连接关系、中心节点或图距离排列网络
  - [树布局](/docs/guides/layout-trees): 用脑图、缩进树和鱼骨图展示父子关系
- 元素 Element
  - [元素总览](/docs/elements/overview): 查看 G6Lite 节点、边、分组的内置形态、元素构成、状态和自定义示例
  - [节点总览](/docs/elements/node): 了解 G6Lite 的内置节点、自定义节点、节点数据结构、样式配置和状态
  - [边总览](/docs/elements/edge): 了解边的方向、内置类型、数据结构与配置方法
  - [分组总览](/docs/elements/combo): 了解分组的用途、成员归属和基本配置
- 性能与原理
  - [性能对比](/docs/metrics/performance): 同一图数据下 G6Lite、G6、Sigma.js 与 ECharts 的首绘耗时和浏览器包体积
- 开始使用
  - [技术架构](/docs/concepts/architecture): 图运行时、绘制图层、渲染调度与布局交互如何协作
- 排查与升级
  - [浏览器与运行环境](/docs/compatibility/browser): 实际能力、ESM、Worker、CSP、SSR 和设备验收边界
  - [从 G6 v5 迁移](/docs/compatibility/g6-v5-migration): 逐项迁移配置、数据、交互、事件和扩展，保留可回退的业务基线
  - [故障排查](/docs/compatibility/troubleshooting): 排查画布、布局、交互与接入问题，按症状找到检查步骤
- 示例
  - [图表示例](/docs/examples): 按 G6Lite 公开能力分类浏览并直接运行官网示例
  - [最简关系图](/docs/examples/basic): 使用最少配置渲染一个可缩放、可拖拽的关系图
  - [默认主题与交互状态](/docs/examples/default-theme): 并排检查 light、dark 预设主题和节点、边默认状态
  - [节点数据映射样式](/docs/examples/node-style): 按业务字段动态设置节点颜色、尺寸和高亮交互
  - [常用布局切换](/docs/examples/layouts): 在同一份数据上切换 circular、force、grid 和 dagre
  - [悬停高亮](/docs/examples/hover): 悬停节点或边时高亮关联元素，并淡化其余元素。
  - [Tooltip 浮层](/docs/examples/tooltip): 悬停节点或边时展示自定义业务信息
  - [图形类型](/docs/examples/shapes): 并排查看圆形和矩形节点。
  - [200 节点](/docs/examples/large): 用 200 个节点快速查看中等规模图的渲染和交互。
  - [5000 节点与标签](/docs/examples/large-labeled): 在 5000 个节点上绘制 Canvas 标签。
  - [边状态与权重](/docs/examples/edge-states): 用权重映射边宽，并查看边的状态样式。
  - [边类型](/docs/examples/edge-types): 展示直线、虚线、弧线和曲线。
  - [边颜色](/docs/examples/edge-colors): 按业务分类给边映射颜色。
  - [边与箭头方向](/docs/examples/edge-arrows): 比较无箭头、单向、双向和粗边箭头
  - [自环边](/docs/examples/edge-loops): 展示一个节点上的单条和多层嵌套自环。
  - [交互热区](/docs/examples/edge-hit-area): 保持细线外观，同时扩大直线、曲线和自环的拾取范围。
  - [平行边与反向边](/docs/examples/parallel-edges): 自动错开同源同目标的多条边、反向边和单边
  - [呼吸节点](/docs/examples/breathing-node): 用自定义节点动画表现选中和高亮状态。
  - [节点边框与圆角](/docs/examples/node-border): 调整描边、线宽和矩形圆角。
  - [流程图](/docs/examples/flowchart): 用层级布局和折线边绘制决策流程。
  - [人物关系网络](/docs/examples/relationship): 使用力导布局和关系标签展示人物关联
  - [组织架构图](/docs/examples/org-chart): 使用层级布局展示组织与团队关系
  - [缩进树](/docs/examples/indented-tree): 用缩进布局展示目录结构。
  - [思维导图](/docs/examples/mindmap): 围绕中心主题展开双向知识分支
  - [鱼骨图](/docs/examples/fishbone): 将问题、分类与原因组织为鱼骨归因结构
  - [全量替换数据](/docs/examples/set-data): 用 setData 替换整图数据，并在替换后切换布局。
  - [标签位置与图标](/docs/examples/labels): 展示节点标签、边标签、图标，并在运行时切换位置。
  - [标签渲染策略](/docs/examples/label-rendering-options): 对比固定字号、低缩放持续绘制和关闭碰撞隐藏。
  - [自定义标签渲染](/docs/examples/custom-label-renderer): 节点和边共用一个自定义 Label Renderer。
  - [Combo 分组容器](/docs/examples/combo): 展示嵌套分组、折叠展开、运行时归组和数据导出
  - [自定义节点与显式边 ID](/docs/examples/custom-node-extension): 注册自定义节点，并使用显式边 ID 与 Combo 状态。
  - [AI Papers 大规模关系图](/docs/examples/real-dataset): 使用真实论文引用网络验证大图渲染和交互链路
  - [扩展系统综合示例](/docs/examples/extension-system): 组合验证 decoration、edge、layout、transform、behavior 和 plugin 扩展
  - [节点与边增删改](/docs/examples/data-mutations): 集中演示节点和边的单个、批量新增、更新和删除
  - [查询、批量状态与可见性](/docs/examples/queries-and-states): 验证元素、邻接、状态查询，以及批量状态和可见性控制
  - [视口与坐标转换](/docs/examples/viewport-controls): 验证 camera、fit、zoom、focus、resize 和屏幕/图坐标互转
  - [更多布局示例](/docs/examples/layout-gallery): 比较 radial、concentric、ForceAtlas2、fruchterman、MDS 和 random
  - [点选、框选与拉索选择](/docs/examples/selection-behaviors): 在同一示例中比较 click、brush 和 lasso 选择行为
  - [拖拽边端点](/docs/examples/drag-edge): 把边的端点拖到另一个节点上，完成重新连线。
  - [搜索并聚焦](/docs/examples/search-focus): 按名称搜索节点，高亮匹配项并把视口移过去。
  - [折线与正交路由](/docs/examples/polyline-routing): 用圆角正交折线连接从左到右的流程节点。
  - [Worker 布局](/docs/examples/layout-worker): 把力导向计算放到 Web Worker，避免挡住主线程。
  - [辐射树](/docs/examples/radial-tree): 用辐射布局把一棵主题树铺在中心节点周围。
  - [调用链](/docs/examples/dependency-graph): 用从左到右的层级布局展示服务之间的调用关系。
  - [拖拽节点与 Combo](/docs/examples/drag-node): 拖拽单个节点，或拖拽 Combo 背景带动其中的节点。
  - [一度邻居高亮](/docs/examples/neighbor-highlight): 悬停节点高亮邻居和连边，悬停边高亮两端节点。
  - [事件面板](/docs/examples/event-log): 点击、拖拽和选择节点时，查看 Graph 发出的公开事件。
  - [右键菜单](/docs/examples/context-menu): 在节点上打开右键菜单，执行聚焦或高亮。
  - [缩放范围与灵敏度](/docs/examples/zoom-options): 把滚轮缩放限制在指定灵敏度和最小、最大比例之间。
  - [注册自定义交互](/docs/examples/custom-behavior): 注册一个 Behavior：点击节点时选中它，点击画布时清除。
  - [自定义布局](/docs/examples/custom-layout): 注册一个把节点排成两行的布局扩展。
  - [节点徽章](/docs/examples/decoration-badges): 在节点边界堆叠计数、状态和文本徽章。

# Documentation

- [What is G6Lite?](/en/docs): Lightweight graph visualization, built for large-scale relationship data
- Getting started
  - [Quick start](/en/docs/getting-started/quick-start): Install G6Lite and create your first interactive graph
  - [React integration](/en/docs/getting-started/react): Create a graph and update its data in a React component
  - [Vue integration](/en/docs/getting-started/vue): Create a graph and update its data in a Vue 3 component
- [G6Lite AI Guide](/en/docs/ai): Use the AI Skill to write graph code in your project and ask Sive for API guidance and examples.
- API
  - [API documentation has moved](/en/docs/api): Find public interfaces in Graph API, Event reference, and Configuration options.
  - Graph API
    - [Graph API](/en/docs/api/graph): Look up the graph constructor, instance methods, events, and extension APIs
    - [Events](/en/docs/api/graph/events): Look up when graph events fire and what their handlers receive.
  - [Graph options](/en/docs/api/options): GraphOptions fields, defaults, and detailed configuration by topic
  - [Extension reference](/en/docs/api/extensions): Configuration, context, drawing callbacks, and lifecycle for extensions.
- Graph
  - [Graph overview](/en/docs/graph/overview): Learn about the Graph lifecycle, options, and instance properties, and run a complete example
- Usage guides
  - [Viewport and coordinates](/en/docs/guides/viewport): Fit the canvas, preserve the user view, convert coordinates, and position menus
  - [Extension system](/en/docs/guides/extensions): Choose configuration or an extension, then follow the relevant tutorial and contract
  - [Data](/en/docs/guides/data): Understand graph data, node and edge operations, Combo groups, and remote loading
  - [Element states](/en/docs/guides/states): Style selection and highlighting, update states, and restore selection after data changes
  - [Common node options](/en/docs/guides/node): Choose shapes, map data and states, add labels, icons and badges, and update nodes at runtime
  - [Custom nodes](/en/docs/guides/custom-node): Register business nodes, add lightweight overlays and decoration anchors, and verify updates
  - [Custom node decorations](/en/docs/guides/custom-decoration): Measure and draw content while configuring placement, stacking, sorting, overflow, and collisions
  - [Common edge options](/en/docs/guides/edge): Choose edge types and configure appearance, labels, interactions, parallel edges, and routing
  - [Custom edges](/en/docs/guides/custom-edge): Reuse built-in edge bases with data-driven styles, states, and data updates
  - [Common combo options](/en/docs/guides/combo): Configure combo outlines, labels, states, collapsed shapes, and membership
  - [Labels and icons](/en/docs/guides/label): Configure node and edge labels, node icons, long text, visibility policies, and runtime updates
  - [Custom Label Renderer](/en/docs/guides/custom-label-renderer): Render multiline node and edge content while retaining engine positioning, rotation, collision, and scheduling
  - [Layout overview](/en/docs/guides/layout-overview): Choose a layout and compare how it arranges the same graph
  - [Common layout options](/en/docs/guides/layout): Choose a network or tree layout, retain existing coordinates, and rearrange at runtime
  - [Grid layout](/en/docs/guides/layout-grid): Arrange nodes in a grid of rows and columns.
  - [Circular layout](/en/docs/guides/layout-circular): Arrange nodes around a circle or vary the radius to form a spiral.
  - [Dagre layout](/en/docs/guides/layout-dagre): Arrange nodes in layers based on directed edges.
  - [Force layout](/en/docs/guides/layout-force): Attraction pulls linked nodes together and repulsion keeps nodes apart.
  - [D3 force layout](/en/docs/guides/layout-d3-force): Use D3’s force simulation to position nodes.
  - [ForceAtlas2 layout](/en/docs/guides/layout-force-atlas2): Connected nodes attract while repulsion and gravity shape the network.
  - [Fruchterman layout](/en/docs/guides/layout-fruchterman): Balance edge attraction and node repulsion, with gravity pulling the graph inward.
  - [Concentric layout](/en/docs/guides/layout-concentric): Place nodes in rings by a ranking metric, with higher values near the center.
  - [Indented tree layout](/en/docs/guides/layout-indented): List nodes in traversal order and indent them by depth.
  - [Mind map layout](/en/docs/guides/layout-mindmap): Expand branches to one or both sides of a central topic.
  - [Fishbone layout](/en/docs/guides/layout-fishbone): Place a problem at the end of a spine, with cause categories on either side.
  - [Radial layout](/en/docs/guides/layout-radial): Place nodes in rings by shortest-path distance from a focal node.
  - [MDS layout](/en/docs/guides/layout-mds): Multidimensional scaling (MDS) approximates shortest-path distances in two dimensions.
  - [Random layout](/en/docs/guides/layout-random): Scatter nodes randomly around the layout center.
  - [Worker layout guide](/en/docs/guides/layout-worker): Run layouts asynchronously, cancel stale tasks, and verify Worker fallback and deployment assets
  - [Custom layouts](/en/docs/guides/custom-layout): Register position calculations, handle options and cancellation, and distinguish Graph execution from standalone calculation
  - [Interaction overview](/en/docs/guides/behavior-overview): Browse built-in behaviors, configure and switch them, and listen for graph events.
  - [Common behavior options](/en/docs/guides/behaviors): Combine navigation, selection, dragging, highlighting, and Tooltip with application events
  - [Drag canvas](/en/docs/guides/behavior-drag-canvas): Drag empty space to pan the graph.
  - [Zoom canvas](/en/docs/guides/behavior-zoom-canvas): Use the mouse wheel to zoom around the canvas center.
  - [Click to select](/en/docs/guides/behavior-click-select): Click a node or edge to toggle selection. Click empty canvas to clear it.
  - [Brush select](/en/docs/guides/behavior-brush-select): Drag a rectangle to select nodes whose centers fall inside it.
  - [Lasso select](/en/docs/guides/behavior-lasso-select): Trace a freehand outline to select nodes whose centers fall inside it.
  - [Drag nodes and combos](/en/docs/guides/behavior-drag-node): Drag a node, or drag empty space within a combo to move the entire combo.
  - [Drag edge endpoints](/en/docs/guides/behavior-drag-edge): Drag an endpoint of an existing edge and use the drop event to read the proposed connection.
  - [Highlight on node hover](/en/docs/guides/behavior-highlight-node): Hover a node to emphasize it, its immediate neighbors, and their connecting edges.
  - [Highlight on edge hover](/en/docs/guides/behavior-highlight-edge): Hover an edge to emphasize it and its two endpoints.
  - [Highlight neighbors](/en/docs/guides/behavior-hover-highlight): Highlight a node’s neighborhood or an edge and its endpoints on hover.
  - [Tooltip](/en/docs/guides/behavior-tooltip): Show details for a node or edge on hover or click.
  - [Custom interactions](/en/docs/guides/custom-behavior): Implement isolated business selection with registration, activation, and cleanup
  - [Plugin overview](/en/docs/guides/plugins): Learn how to configure, replace, and unmount plugins in G6Lite
  - [Custom Plugins](/en/docs/guides/custom-plugin): Implement, register, and use a click counter plugin
  - [Transforms](/en/docs/guides/transform-overview): Learn when transforms run and how to configure parallel edges and custom transforms
  - [Themes](/en/docs/guides/theme): Choose a preset, apply brand colors, switch themes, and troubleshoot style overrides
  - [Zoom and pan the canvas](/en/docs/guides/behavior-navigation): Set wheel speed, zoom limits, and drag-to-pan gestures
  - [Click, brush, and lasso selection](/en/docs/guides/behavior-selection): Configure click selection for nodes and edges and area selection for nodes
  - [Drag nodes, combos, and edges](/en/docs/guides/behavior-dragging): Move nodes and combos or reconnect an edge endpoint
  - Event basics
    - [Event basics](/en/docs/guides/events): Start with a click listener and connect canvas interactions to your application
    - [Selection and dragging](/en/docs/guides/events/selection-drag): Synchronize selection, persist drag results, and clean up listeners
    - [Rendering, layout, and data updates](/en/docs/guides/events/lifecycle): Know when to update the graph, read node positions, or respond to data replacement.
    - [Custom events](/en/docs/guides/events/custom): Dispatch an application event from a toolbar button and clean up its listeners on unmount.
  - [Grid, circular, and layered layouts](/en/docs/guides/layout-arrangements): Arrange nodes with Grid, Circular, and Dagre
  - [Network layouts](/en/docs/guides/layout-networks): Arrange networks by connections, a focal node, or graph distance
  - [Tree layouts](/en/docs/guides/layout-trees): Show parent-child relationships with mind maps, indented trees, and fishbone diagrams
